collection.title: BYD Seal U 2024 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BYD Seal U 2024 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
